data.name: Iolanthe
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Iolanthe is the name of a nymph who was transformed into a violet flower. In Christianity, it is the name of a saint, Iolanthe of the Isles, who was a hermit and a healer.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes transformation, spiritual growth, and healing.

in_hebrew.meaning: שם שמי יהודי, פירוש: 'אלה של יול'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם שמי יהודי, פירוש: 'אלה של יול' - יול הוא שם שמי עברי המקור, שמשמעותו נושא. יולנת' היא גרסה נוצרית של יול, עם סיומת נקבית. יולנת' יכולה להיות נצרות, שמעון ואחר, וכן, כביכול, 'אלה של יול'.

in_english.name: Iolanthe
in_english.long_meaning: Christian name, description: 'religious origin' - The name Iolanthe originates from the Greek word 'ioulos' meaning 'throne' and in sequentia 'Iolanthe' meaning 'throne of God'. In Christian tradition, the name Iolanthe is associated with the divine throne and the heavenly kingdom. It symbolizes spiritual elevation, nobility, and a deep connection with the divine. In modern times, the name Iolanthe is used in various Christian cultures to signify a child's spiritual journey and their aspiration to reach the heavenly throne.

data.cultural_impact: Iolanthe is a beautiful and unique name with Greek origins, evoking images of mystical nymphs and ancient mythology. However, in Christian contexts, it takes on a new meaning as the name of a saint known for her sanctity and devotion.
data.spiritual_significance: Iolanthe's spiritual significance lies in her transformation - from a beautiful nymph to a violet flower, and later to a revered saint. This name signifies the idea of transformation and growth, both in the natural world and in the spiritual realm. It also serves as a reminder of the divine potential within each of us to transcend our current state and become something greater. Additionally, as a healer, Iolanthe represents the power of faith and the capacity to offer comfort and healing to those who seek it.
